blind_spots.blind_spot: NeuroSight is pitched as a 'Visual Augmentation System' for SOF Warrior situational awareness but never mentions ATAK/TAK integration anywhere on the site.
blind_spots.operator_reality: SOF operators already run their sensor and comms picture through ATAK — a vision system that doesn't speak TAK protocol becomes a second screen nobody carries, no matter how good the sensor is.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Team appears optics/AI-first (event-sensor hardware) and may be treating TAK integration as a later software task rather than day-one architecture.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: designed to integrate seamlessly with AI/ ML platforms, enabling real-time detection, tracking, and control

blind_spots.blind_spot: QuickTurn moves maintenance data via 'tablet-based scanning' from deployed sites back to depots with no mention of offline sync, ATO for the tablet software, or how data survives a DDIL link between field and depot.
blind_spots.operator_reality: A depot maintenance tool that assumes a live link home is exactly the 30fps-video failure mode — the tablet needs to capture and batch-sync when comms return, and the software needs an ATO to touch government maintenance systems at all.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: REVISE/QuickTurn language is written from the depot-efficiency angle (corrosion, work queues), not the connectivity angle.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: replacing text-based records...with spatially captured ground truth

blind_spots.blind_spot: A 4-5 person team is simultaneously running three separate SBIR Phase I threads (NeuroSight/VAS, ATLAS, REVISE) plus claiming prime-contractor status on multiple military contracts, with zero CMMC/NIST 800-171 language anywhere public.
blind_spots.operator_reality: Each Phase I has its own clock to a Phase II decision; a team this thin juggling three award threads plus undocumented compliance posture is exactly the profile that misses a Phase II proposal window because engineering time went to the wrong thread.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Small team, high award velocity — compliance and program-management overhead is easy to defer when the team is this size.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: We perform as prime contractor on several military contracts, as well as provide engineering services to third parties

opener_hook: Merge Plot's USSOCOM Phase I for PEO SOF Warrior's Visual Augmentation System is public, and NeuroSight just opened commercial orders — neither mentions ATAK integration.
what_they_do: Builds ruggedized event-based vision sensors (NeuroSight), counter-UAS/GenAI mission-planning (ATLAS), and maintenance digital-twin tools (QuickTurn/REVISE) for defense, funded via SOCOM/Army/AF SBIRs.
